name: Ikase Otoko Nyuumon ~Ai o Arigatou~
original_name: イカセ男入門 ～愛をありがとう～
source:
Choosing the right answer out of the list gradually gets the leaf red resulting in CG.
Choosing the wrong answer makes the player drink milk which eventually results in game over.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
从选项中选出正确答案，叶片便会逐渐染红，最终解锁CG。
如果选错，玩家就得喝下牛奶；错得太多，游戏便会宣告结束。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-year-1990.html]vndbreview[/url]]
